blocks.prompt: 8. A sum of Rs. 5000 is invested [printed as 'inverted'] at 8% simple interest per year. Calculate the interest at the end of each year. Do these interests form an A.P.? If so find the interest at the end of 20 years making use of this fact.
blocks.explanation:
Simple interest mein munafa hamesha asal raqam Rs. 5000 par lagta hai, munafe par munafa nahi milta. Is liye har saal barabar munafa milta hai.
To saal ke aakhir tak ka kul munafa har saal ek hi raqam se barhta hai, yani A.P.
Plan: ek saal ka munafa nikalenge, har saal ke aakhir ka kul munafa likhenge, farq check karenge, phir \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) se 20 saal ka munafa.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(P = 5000\), simple interest 8% saalana.
Humein find karna hai: har saal ke aakhir ka munafa, kya yeh A.P. hai, aur 20 saal ka munafa.
Tareeqa: Agar list A.P. hui to \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\).

Ek saal ka munafa
\[\dfrac{8}{100} \times 5000 = 400\]
Kyun: 5000 ka 8%: \(\frac{8}{100} \times 5000 = 8 \times 50 = 400\). Simple interest mein har saal yahi 400 milta hai, kyunke munafa hamesha asal 5000 par lagta hai; pichhle saal ka munafa asal raqam mein shamil nahi hota. Compound interest (sawal 2) se yahi farq hai: wahan har saal munafa barhta tha, yahan barabar rehta hai.

Har saal ke aakhir ka kul munafa
\[400,\ 800,\ 1200,\ 1600,\ \ldots\]
Kyun: Sawal "interest at the end of each year" poochta hai, yani us saal ke aakhir tak ka kul munafa. Pehle saal ke aakhir 400, doosre ke aakhir \(400 + 400 = 800\), teesre ke 1200, waghera. Har saal 400 judta hai.
Dhyan dein: har saal ka alag munafa 400, 400, 400, ... bhi A.P. hai (\(d = 0\)), lekin "20 saal ke aakhir ka munafa" kul munafa hai, is liye hum jama wali list lete hain.

Check karein ke kya yeh A.P. hai
\[800 - 400 = 400\]
\[1200 - 800 = 400\]
\[a_1 = 400,\ d = 400\]
Kyun: A.P. ki pehchaan: saath wale terms ka farq hamesha barabar. Yahan har farq 400 hai, is liye haan, yeh A.P. hai, \(a_1 = 400\) aur \(d = 400\).

20 saal ka munafa
\[a_{20} = 400 + (20 - 1)(400)\]
\[= 400 + 7600 = 8000\]
Kyun: 20 saal ke aakhir ka kul munafa is A.P. ka 20th term hai. \(19 \times 400 = 7600\), aur 400 jama kar ke 8000.
Tasdeeq: simple interest ka formula \(I = P \times \text{rate} \times \text{time} = 5000 \times 0.08 \times 20 = 8000\), wahi jawab.
blocks.final_answer: Munafa 400, 800, 1200, ... A.P. hai; 20 saal ka munafa = Rs. 8000

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein "is inverted at 8% simple interest" chhapa hai; sahi lafz "invested" (invest kiya gaya) hai. Yeh sirf chhapai ki ghalti hai, hisaab par koi asar nahi.
